$V=\{\alpha \vec{P}+\beta \vec{Q}: \alpha, \beta \in \mathbb{R}\}$
Then
options: for any vector $\vec{R}, \vec{R} \times(\vec{P} \times \vec{Q})$ is an element of $V$.
